expectations: Normal render reads the actual current host message again; prior source-check results, source parameters or forged proofs cannot authorize delivery.
A correctly bound positive projection can deliver source-derived explanation, labels and node/edge/path notes; arbitrary model summaries/annotations are not part of the grounded display.
Unbound Client alias, reversed access, forbidden positive edge or wrong pair mode cannot be delivered as source-bound.
Unsupported complete permission source is refused; unrelated generic render may remain explicitly source-unverified.
Persisted metadata contains exactly the validated final display snapshot, not mutable args.view or a different revision. No full spec is echoed to the model.
Fresh revisions and turns recheck current input. Replay restores only the final source-derived payload/explanation and rejects mismatched turn/revision evidence.
Normal Native/PTC, folded tools and one necessary refresh/history reopen are checked narrowly; old checkpoint/protocol/template reading remains compatible.
